items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: I played one of the two Jaws alto with the, Henry Allen. ... I played several funerals and parades with him.

ctx.x: What about any parades when you were a boy? I actually heard...

Oh, well, I used to run all the parades, and all the advertisement on the... I was a band that was playing on the corner. I'd be out there. And the parades, and my mother never allowed me to follow the parades. But if they came around the neighborhood I'd follow them a block or two anyway. I used to love the music. Did you ever play, you might as well get that down here too, ever play in any brass bands? Yes. I played one of the two Jaws alto with the, I played one of the two Jaws alto with the, Henry Allen.
